company.name: Arrakis Technologies
company.shortDescription: Arrakis Technologies develops AI agent platforms that automate complex industrial and supply chain operations.
company.description: Arrakis Technologies develops an AI operating system and agent platform for real-world industrial and supply chain operations. The company combines a model-agnostic AI platform with embedded teams to map enterprise workflows, connect ERPs and other operational systems, and ingest unstructured data such as emails, PDFs, and spreadsheets. Its agents execute multi-step business processes across areas like procurement, chartering, manufacturing, energy, and shipping, while maintaining human oversight through approvals and governance logic. Arrakis focuses on building governed AI workflows that include role-based access controls, audit trails, and policy alignment. Its software integrates with common enterprise systems, AI model providers, data warehouses, and document repositories to create a unified operational context for automation. The platform is designed for regulated, high-stakes environments where data protection and traceability are required.
